name: Ammunition of Slaying (Elemental)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Elemental it hits makes a DC 17 Con save: 6d10 extra Piercing, half on a success; then it's ordinary.
text: This magic ammunition is meant to slay creatures of the Elemental type. If a creature of that type takes damage from the ammunition, it makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 6d10 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much extra damage on a successful one. Once it deals its extra damage, it becomes nonmagical.
